trace.final:
Done. Summary of actions:

1. **Diagnosed**: checkout-api v2.3.1 was unhealthy in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an ~18% error rate. Release history showed the most recent healthy production version was **v2.3.0**.
2. **Rolled back**: All regions were rolled back to v2.3.0. Verified post-rollback that the service is now **healthy** in all regions with an ~0.2% error rate.
3. **Opened incident**: Created SEV2 incident **INC-0001** ("checkout-api failing health checks; rolled back v2.3.1 -> v2.3.0") describing the failure and the rollback, and the on-call engineer has been paged.

Note: the root cause of the v2.3.1 failure is still under investigation, so hold off on redeploying that version until it's identified and fixed.
